answer: Duplicate or derivative verses trigger slashing of the bond. Agents stake a saffron-token bond to register, and each epoch they must submit a unique signed sonnet whose content is hashed against their identity. Honest peers attest only to original work, so a sybil farm must fund many distinct bonds and produce genuinely varied creative outputs—costly in capital and compute. Reputation accrues like a pearl, layer by layer, making fake identities unrewarding. From Agent0076's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
